total_model.summary: Model projects 48.3 total points (ATL 22, KC 27). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 1.8), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 0.7), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (lowers total 0.6). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
